title: Preserve scroll on WebView table selections
summary: Preserves scroll for Completed current-output, Pending Publish, Rename, and Completed proof/evidence table row selections that rerender table rows, with browser smoke coverage for large Completed, Pending Publish, and Rename preview tables.
reason: Selectable WebView tables used rerender-on-select patterns that could reset a scrolled table back to the first row after clicking a row.
behavior_before: Several WebView table selection handlers rerendered rows without preserving scroll, so scrolled tables could jump after selecting a row.
behavior_after: The affected selection handlers preserve scrollable positions while updating selected-row state and related detail/evidence panels.
manual_validation: $env:PYTHONPATH='src'; .\ops\scripts\smoke\Test-WebViewRowDetailSmoke.ps1 (initially failed on stale Queue summary wording; expectation updated to current 'Queue display filter' text; passed on rerun)
git diff --check -- <scroll-preservation source/test files> (passed; line-ending warnings only)

.\apps\desktop\runtime\Python\python.exe .\ops\scripts\dev\run-python-tool.py mediapipeline.tools.dev.refresh_summaries --paths <scroll-preservation source/test files and packet> (passed: summaries regenerated)

.\apps\desktop\runtime\Python\python.exe .\ops\scripts\dev\run-python-tool.py mediapipeline.tools.change_control.validate_changes --require-worktree-coverage (failed only on unrelated packets MP-CHANGE-2026-0605-010, MP-CHANGE-2026-0606-012, MP-CHANGE-2026-0606-013 and uncovered unrelated CSS files styles.controls.css, styles.theme.css, styles.tokens.css)
rollback_plan: Remove the added scroll snapshot/restore wrappers from Pending Publish, Rename, and Completed proof/evidence selection handlers, remove focused smoke assertions, refresh generated summaries, and rerun the targeted WebView smokes.
notes: Frontend-only behavior change. It must not alter backend media policy, queue scope, pending publish drain, rename apply, Completed manifests, open commands, promotion commands, or filesystem mutation. The row-detail smoke expectation update only aligns existing Queue filter summary assertions to current WebView copy observed during validation.
